title: Ring tool: no hover preview while orbiting the camera
description:
User report 2026-10-04: orbiting inside the ring tool keeps recomputing the ring hover preview under the cursor every frame, which is laggy on the crawfish scan. While the camera is being orbited, panned or zoomed, the hover preview is not computed or drawn; it resumes when the camera stops and the cursor rests. (CRAW-43 tracks the preview's own cost on body-scale rings separately.)

Rework (user review, 2026-10-06): the view-matrix watcher with a 250 ms rest timer is rejected as a hack. It also fails the real case: click and drag to orbit, stop moving in the middle of the drag, and the hover preview comes back after 250 ms although the button is still held and moving again continues the orbit. The rule is the input state: while a drag is in progress (a mouse button held that the camera, not the tool, owns), the tool computes and draws no hover preview, however long the cursor rests; it resumes on release. The input layer must let a tool query that state through a generic, client-free API (e.g. on MouseTrap or PointerDispatcher: whether a button is held and whether the press belongs to the camera or to a region/tool), without the tool reaching into OrbitMouseTrap internals and without OrbitMouseTrap knowing about tools. Remove the view-matrix comparison and CAMERA_REST_NANOS. State in the report what wheel zoom does (no drag state) and why.

Rework 2 (user review, 2026-10-06): (1) MouseTrap.isCameraDragging() returning false in the base class is wrong: the base trap and its 2D subclasses (Scene2DMousePanTrap, TradeMouseTrap, FlyCamMouseTrap) also drag the view. The drag state belongs in MouseTrap itself, set and cleared by the shared press/drag/release path every trap goes through, so every trap reports it; OrbitMouseTrap keeps only what is specific to it (a press the tool grabbed is not a camera drag). (2) Zooming must also pause the ring tool's hover: updating the hover preview on every wheel step lags and is annoying. Expose a zoom-in-progress state from the input layer next to the drag state and have the hover skip while either holds. GLFW reports no scroll start or end, so if a settle window after the last wheel event is unavoidable, it lives in MouseTrap as part of the zoom state (not in the tool), is counted in frames or input events rather than ad hoc wall time if possible, is documented, and the report says plainly how it behaves at the end of a trackpad gesture.
definition-of-done:
1. During an orbit drag or wheel zoom no preview is computed (log or counter shows zero previews over the drag, debug counter removed before landing unless named here). 2. The preview returns after the camera stops. 3. Orbit frame time on the crawfish no longer includes preview cost.

No view-matrix watching and no rest timer: hover suppression follows the queried drag state only. Holding a camera drag still for any length of time shows no preview; release brings it back. A unit test drives press, still-hold and release through the input layer and checks the preview state at each step.

No new class or interface: the drag state is exposed by a small read-only method on the existing input classes (PointerDispatcher / MouseTrap), which already hold it (user, 2026-10-06).

Drag state lives in MouseTrap's shared input path and is true for drags in every trap (orbit and 2D), not only OrbitMouseTrap. A zoom in progress pauses the hover too; the end-of-zoom behaviour is tested and documented.
testing-plan: 1. ixdar-cli drag-orbit on the crawfish; compare frame times before and after.
changes-made: RingTool.perFrame skips the GPU pick, and so the hover preview fit, until the camera view matrix has rested CAMERA_REST_NANOS (250 ms) since it last changed, unless a click waits or an anchor is being dragged; detection compares Camera3D.view frame to frame, so orbit, pan, wheel zoom, keys and orbit-set all count without touching OrbitMouseTrap. Crawfish 40-step drag-orbit: 26 previews -> 0, tool per-frame mean 19.7 ms (max 145) -> 0.31 ms (max 3.5), drag step wall 90.8 -> 46.7 ms; 10 wheel steps: 10 previews -> 0; preview returns once the camera rests.

Rework: the view-matrix watcher and CAMERA_REST_NANOS rest timer are gone. Hover suppression follows the input layer's drag state: OrbitMouseTrap.isCameraDragging() (MouseTrap base: false) is set by the first drag move of a left press the tool did not grab and cleared on release, held still or moving; PointerDispatcher.isCameraDragging(trap) adds that no PointerRegion holds the press; ModelScene.cameraDragInProgress() asks the platform's dispatcher; RingTool.hoverPaused() reads it and perFrame skips the GPU pick (so no preview fit or draw) while it holds. Anchor drags (toolGrab) and unmoved presses never pause it. Wheel zoom has no drag state, so the preview follows the cursor's new hit on the next frame; no timer. input/drag gained a 'hold' param (frames with the button held still before release). RingCameraDragHoverTest drives press, 30 still frames and release through PointerDispatcher and an anchor drag. Live fertility: previewValid false throughout a ~4 s still hold, preview back on release. Crawfish: drag-orbit 44.7 ms/step vs hover sweep (preview every frame) 64.8 ms/step, still hold 19.5 ms/frame.

Rework 2: drag and zoom state live in MouseTrap, fed by the shared PointerDispatcher path for every trap (orbit, Scene2DMousePanTrap, TradeMouseTrap, FlyCamMouseTrap, base). trackPress/trackDrag keep heldPressPosition/heldPressDragged: a left press becomes a drag once it moves past CLICK_DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX, held still or moving, until release; isCameraDragging() reads it, and OrbitMouseTrap only overrides it to exclude a toolGrab press. trackZoomFrame runs each frame before the trap drains its wheel: a delta the trap zooms with (usesWheel, not claimed by a region) sets zoomSettleFramesLeft = ZOOM_SETTLE_FRAMES (10), other frames count down; isZooming() is true until it reaches 0. PointerDispatcher.isCameraDragging removed. ModelScene.cameraMoving() = drag or zoom, read in RingTool.perFrame. RingCameraDragHoverTest: orbit press/wobble/drag/30 still frames/release, wheel burst then exactly 10 settle frames, Scene2DMousePanTrap drag, anchor drag never pauses. mvn test 430 green. Live fertility: 20-event scroll burst previewValid false throughout, no fit (previewMillis unchanged), back after settle; drag with hold 400 frames previewValid false over 30 polls. Crawfish: 20-event burst, no preview fit during it (previewMillis unchanged), preview back after settle.
